name: 62806 · Albion, IL
findings: ZIP 62806 (Albion) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62806 (Albion) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
60% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
